description: Move collateral from the position back to the account, never to any other address. "max" stops at the account's minimum ratio. Checks the account's limits, then returns UNSIGNED transaction data for the session key, simulated first. Above the approval threshold it returns EIP-712 typed data for the owner instead, which only works when the owner is an ordinary wallet: it refuses when the owner is a contract, such as a Safe. Never signs or sends.

amount.description: USDG to withdraw as a decimal string, or "max"

approval.description: Only above the approval threshold: the nonce and deadline from typedData, plus the owner's signature

signature.description: The owner's EIP-712 signature over typedData

approvalTtlSeconds.description: Optional: how long a new approval stays valid. Default 1 hour

market.description: Market address (0x...) or symbol, e.g. NO-NVDA

sessionKey.description: The session key that will send it (0x...). Not held by this server

name: prepare_mandate_withdraw_collateral
title: Prepare mandate collateral withdraw
